environment.description: Application deployed on a single EC2 instance (t3.medium) running Amazon Linux 2, behind an Application Load Balancer with default listener rules (forward all to target group). Security group allows inbound 443 from 0.0.0.0/0. No additional managed rule groups attached to the ALB. The Flask app runs directly via gunicorn with 4 workers, exposed on port 8080. The ALB terminates TLS and forwards to the instance on port 8080.
